title: You thought God only speaks peace.
paragraphs: You thought God only speaks peace.
But here—He commands war.

Not against people.
Against everything destroying your soul.

Sin that whispers at night.
Compromise that smiles in daylight.
Weakness that says, “Stay down.”
Then God interrupts:
“Turn your tools into weapons.”

What you used for comfort—
now becomes your fight.

What you called weakness—
God calls to rise.
And then the line that shakes the timid:
“Let the weak say, I am strong.”

Not because you are.
But because He is.

This is not hype.
This is identity shift.
But here’s what we miss…

Joel wasn’t preaching self-confidence.
He was calling a people back to God.
Because strength without repentance is still weakness.
And that’s where grace walks in.

At the cross of Jesus Christ,
the weakest moment—death—
became the greatest victory.

Sin lost.
Shame broke.
Power shifted.
Now the weak don’t pretend strength…
They receive it.

Through surrender.
Through repentance.
Through Christ alone.
So if you feel tired, trapped, or torn—
Say it anyway:
“In Jesus, I am strong.”

Not because you deserve it.
But because He finished it.
